title: Bias library (2): disposition, overconfidence, confirmation, mental accounting
objectives: Recognise disposition effect, overconfidence, confirmation and mental accounting.
Answer each with the manual's “what to say” line.
body_md:
Disposition effect: selling winners too early, holding losers too long. Sounds like: “Sell the winner, keep the loser.” Say: “Let's judge each fund on merit, not on whether it's in profit.” Overconfidence: over-rating one's ability to pick or time. Sounds like: “I'll time the market myself.” Say: “Even professionals struggle to time markets. Missing a few of the best days can cut long-term returns sharply.” Confirmation: seeking only information that agrees. Sounds like: “Everything I read says this will go up.” Say: “Let's look at the case against it too.” Mental accounting: treating money differently by its source. Sounds like: “This bonus is free money to take a risk with.” Say: “It's still your money. Let's put it toward a goal.”

| Bias | What it is | How it sounds | What to say |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Disposition effect | Selling winners too early, holding losers too long | "Sell the winner, keep the loser." | "Let's judge each fund on merit, not on whether it's in profit." |
| Overconfidence | Over-rating one's ability to pick or time | "I'll time the market myself." | "Even professionals struggle to time markets. Missing a few of the best days can cut long-term returns sharply." |
| Confirmation | Seeking only information that agrees | "Everything I read says this will go up." | "Let's look at the case against it too." |
| Mental accounting | Treating money differently by its source | "This bonus is free money to take a risk with." | "It's still your money. Let's put it toward a goal." |
example: “This bonus is free money to take a risk with” → mental accounting: “It's still your money. Let's put it toward a goal.”
say: Judge each fund on merit, not on whether it's in profit.
It's still your money. Let's put it toward a goal.
never: Sell winners early, hold losers long.

check.q: Can distributors be affected by recency bias?
o: Yes — e.g. pitching last year's top fund to every client
